The study reveals normal knee joint alignment.   No fracture or bone contusion is seen.  
   Normal ACL orientation with intact ligament is observed.   PCL is intact.  
  MCL is intact.  Linear horizontal peripheral tear at posterior horn of the medial meniscus is noted.  
  Mild hyperintense proximal FCL and popliteus tendon are observed. Biceps femoris tendon is  preserved. 
   Lateral meniscus is not torn.  
  
   There are partialthickness cartilage tear, about 1.3xintact8cm. at lateral trochlea and hyperintense fissuring cartilage surface, about intact9cm., at anterior lateral femoral condyle, without subchondral bone lesion.  
     Partialthickness cartilage tear, about 1.1cm. at mid medial trochlea, without subchondral bone lesion, is detected.  
     Illdefined mild hyperintense cartilage along the medial and lateral patellar facet is observed.   
    Minimal joint effusion with suprapatellar fluid and thickneed synovial tissue are observed.  
   Quadriceps  and patellar tendons are intact.      Multiple cartilaginous defects at the PF joint; 
      partialthickness cartilaginous tear, about 1.3xintact8cm. at lateral trochlea , 
      hyperintense fissuring cartilage surface, about intact9cm., at anterior lateral femoral condyle 
      partialthickness cartilaginous tear, about 1.1cm., at mid medial trochlea, without subchondral bone 
         lesion

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for 3 months after injury playing volleyball.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior root with dominant radial component. No extrusion or displaced fragment.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 16 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Complex tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with dominant radial component. No extrusion or displaced fragment.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Suspected osteochondral injury right knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus is intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 11 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is fissuring of articular cartilage at the central femoral trochlea with focal full thickness cartilage denuding along the medial patellar facet. No evidence of displaced or unstable osteochondral fragment. Femorotibial articular cartilage is preserved.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Focal high-grade patellofemoral chondrosis as detailed above. No evidence of displaced or unstable osteochondral fragment.
2. No evidence of discrete meniscal, ligament, or tendon tear.

Erhaltene Artikulation im rechten Kniegelenk. Deutliches Ödem in der medialen Femurkondyle sowie im medialen Tibiaplateau. Kleinzystische Veränderungen subcortikal an der Patellafacette (5/9). Ansonsten unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Patella zentriert stehend.
Tief greifende chondrale Läsion an der lateralen Patellafacette mit ca. 5 x 7 mm (4/15 oder 7/22). Darunterliegende kleinzystische Veränderungen subcortikal. Weitere tief greifende chondrale Läsion auch an der medialen Patellafacette mit chondraler Ossifikationen mit ca. 6 x 6 mm (4/14 und 7/18). An den Femurkondylen der facies patellaris oberflächliche Chondropathie mit ausgedünntem Knorpelbelag. Auch femorotibial, führend medialseitig multiple tief greifende kontralaterale Läsionen, exemplarisch in der Hauptbelastungszone mit bis zu 4 mm (5/22) oder dorsal an der medialen Femurkondyle (5/24). Am medialen Tibiaplateau zudem kleine osteochondrale Läsion (5/20). Auch lateralseitig führend am dorsalen Tibiaplateau vollschichtige Chondropathie mit darunterliegenden kleinzystischen Veränderungen (1006/82). Die Kreuzbänder intakt. Diskrete Signalanhebung im Außenmeniskushinterhorn und im Bereich der anterioren Anheftungsstelle (6/22), DD bei mukoider Degeneration. Das Innenmeniskushinterhorn ebenfalls deutlich T2 signalalteriert mit komplexer in erster Linie degenerativer Rissbildung im Hinterhorn bis in die Pars intermedia (siehe z. B. 5/22). Der Innenmeniskus bereits gering exkludiert. LCL unauffällig. Schmaler Flüssigkeitssaum Umgebend zum MCL, DD bei Reizzustand. Moderater Gelenkerguss. Synoviale Proliferationen. Minimal Flüssigkeit an Baker Position (3/90). Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Weichteile.

Knochen: Gering Knochenmarksödem an der medialen Femurkondyle in der subchondralen Belastungszone (5/24). Gering zystische Veränderungen der Knochenstruktur am Patellaoberpol (5/7). Desweiteren unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Zentrierte Stellung im Kniegelenk. Zentrierte Stellung der Patella. Einzelne intraossäre Zyste des distalen Femurs intercondylär (5/18). 
Knorpel: Fokal bis vollschichtige Chondropathie retropatellar am Patellafirst (4/12 + 14). An der Trochlea ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz. Ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz an der medialen Femurkondyle im Femorotibialgelenk, fokal mit bis vollschichtiger Chondropathie (6/11+ 5/21). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie im lateralen Kompartiment. 
Kreuzbänder: Intakte Darstellung des Faserverlauf sowie Signalgebung des hinteren Kreuzbandes. Kräftiges anteriores meniscofemorales Ligament. Intakter Verlauf des vorderen Kreuzbandes.
Menisci: Mucoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskusvorderhornes, geringer mucoide Degeneration am Innenmeniskushinterhorn. Keine Rissbildung oder Herniation. Keine parameniscealen Zysten. 
Gelenkkapsel/Kollateralbänder: Gering Gelenkerguss führend suprapatellar. Keine freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper. Mediales und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Geringer Reizzustand des MCL. 
Fettkörper: Unauffällig, kein raumfordernder Prozess. 
Weichteile: CC bis 8 cm ausgedehnte polylobulierte Baker-Zyste in Loco typico (6/5, 5/33).

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı minimal artmış. Distal femur proksimal tibya ve fibula diyafizometafizer kesimlerindeki artmış hematopoitik kemik iliği aktivitesi anemi ile birlikte olabilir. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyona gövdesi düzeyindeki doku kaybının da eşlik ettiği kompleks yırtık ve medyale 5 mm ekstrüzyon eşlik ediyor. Ekstrüde disk iç yan bağı basılıyor ve iç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Çapraz ve dış yan bağ normal. Popliteus tendinozisi insersiyosu düzeyinde ve hafif derecede. Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal patellar faset santralindeki tam kata ulaşan kondral fissür, medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki segmenter tam kat kondral kayıp, eşlik eden subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve milimetrik boyutlu marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Gastroknemyus semimembranozus bursasındaki 4 cm maksimum boyutlu lobüle konturlu sıvı koleksiyonu sızdırmıyor. Prepatellar ve yüzeyel infrapatellar derin cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.
